Landing in Tokyo early and check-in is hours away? The booking you choose decides whether you sightsee with your suitcase. One flat we checked opens its door at 16:00 👇

🔗 Times, prices and the route are all here 👉 https://japanbystation.com/tokyo-early-arrival-luggage

🏨 A STAFFED HOTEL

1️⃣ Sotetsu Fresa Inn Tokyo-Toyocho, as an example, says in its own FAQ that the front desk is open 24 hours and keeps luggage before check-in and after check-out, on those days.

📦 It will also hold bags you courier ahead for up to a week before check-in. It cannot take luggage that is too large or in large quantities, so ask first with many cases.

🏠 AN APARTMENT

2️⃣ The Kinshicho flat we priced has smart check-in, an unmanned desk and check-in from 16:00 to 22:00. Luggage storage is not in its facilities list.

⏳ Land at 8 a.m. and that is eight hours with your bags, unless the host names a real drop-off point. Ask in writing before booking.

🔐 A STATION LOCKER

3️⃣ JR East gives its usual locker prices as S ¥500, M ¥700–800 and L ¥900–1,000, from the first to the last train.

🚉 Ueno alone has 21 locker sites. Outside the Shinobazu gate there are 20 LL and 56 L lockers.

✅ OUR TAKE

Arriving before noon? We'd book a staffed hotel that keeps bags before check-in and drop them on the way from the airport. Apartment with no drop-off: about ¥1,000 for an L locker at the station nearest the flat.
